newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan says citizen released in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Jordan says citizen released in Lebanon.

text.p: A Jordanian executive of a Beirut hotel has been released more than three weeks after he disappeared in Lebanon, Jordan said on Sunday.
A government official said Derar al-Karmi, financial controller at the Marriott Hotel in Beirut, was released on Saturday, but said Jordan still did not know who had detained him and why.

Lebanon's prosecutor-general said last week Karmi, who is of Palestinian origin and disappeared on January 3, was detained on orders of Lebanese military authorities. Jordan's ambassador to Lebanon indicated Karmi was held by the Syrian security forces.
"We welcome his release but we reject any aggression against Jordanian nationals," the government official said. "We don't have any information about who was holding him."

Karmi's mysterious disappearance was followed by Lebanon's decision last week to release three Iraqi diplomats charged with the murder of an Iraqi opposition figure who also had Jordanian nationality.

Jordan protested to Lebanon on Thursday when it freed the three men but Lebanon rejected its complaint, saying under international law Lebanon could not try the three Iraqis since they had diplomatic immunity.
